caption:
Prices rose 0.4% in October. 📈

The BLS says that's more than economists expected, after a 0.6% jump in September. Food was up 0.5%, gas 1.0%, electricity 0.9%.

One month doesn't sound like much, but it stacks up fast.

Which bill jumped the most for you lately?
